premises.text: Beekeepers lose ~40% of bees yearly to pesticides, parasites, and disease, threatening pollination-dependent food and a large rental-hive industry
premises.evidence_span: Every year, we lose about 40% of our bees because of pesticides, parasites, and diseases

premises.text: Manual hive inspections across large multi-site operations discover problems too late, after colonies die
premises.evidence_span: by the time the beekeeper discovers that a hive is having an issue, the hive will die, along with 40% of the whole bee yard

premises.text: Sensor devices translate hive temperature, humidity, sound, weight, and geolocation into a remote health/behavior interface
premises.evidence_span: The beekeepers install our sensor devices in the hive, and we translate its temperature, humidity, sound frequencies, or really the signals that the bees send each other, the weight of the hive and its geolocation

premises.text: Affordable analytics packages (not expensive raw data) improve decision-making to prevent disease and raise apiary profitability
premises.evidence_span: We offer affordable analytics instead of expensive raw data

value.text: Give honeybees a voice so beekeepers can keep hives healthy and provide sustainable pollination

causal_links.evidence_span: beekeepers are struggling to keep their bees alive
prevent diseases instead of reacting to them

notes: Sensor modalities folded into P3 cascade. Three analytic plan SKUs folded into P4 commercial packaging of same analytics offer. Five-hive save / 100 connected hives treated as validation/traction. Expansion-to-10k-hives vision not coded as a separate premise.
